reviews.author: Angelica Finol
reviews.text: We had a great experience working with this team! They built our covered porch and expanded our composite deck, and everything turned out even better than we expected. They were easy to work with, showed up when they said they would, and the quality of their work was excellent. We’re very happy with the final result and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable contractor!

reviews.author: Malik
reviews.text: I hired our general contractor for a full gut renovation, and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish. Al and all of his crews and subs were professional, experienced , and did excellent work across the board, and cleaned up the site before leaving everyday. Our GC kept me consistently updated, and handled everything so well that I never had to manage or worry about a thing. The project moved smoothly, passed inspections right away, and was done the right way with no issues or complaints. I would recommend him a thousand times over and look forward to working with him again on the next project.

reviews.author: Linda Robinson
reviews.text: Ali did an incredible job adding a media wall& wall of mirrors to my new home! He also wallpapered 3 rooms & his work was perfection!!! So easy to work with & very reasonably priced. Highly recommend for any renovations!!!!! Linda Robinson

reviews.author: Denver
reviews.text: BCG is the third contractor I found for our job. 3 time is the charm. We got through inspections for the building addition, quick. I had been stuck between two of those jobs for over a year

reviews.author: Mathew Steele
reviews.text: Al and his team and very professional, nice and know their stuff. Al helped me with a kitchen and two bath Reno on a house that desperately needed it. They were affordable and did an excellent job even thinking of the closet upgrades they added on.

reviews.author: Oksana Pavlenko
reviews.text: This company is amazing! Very good communication and easy to work through all processes. Bowser Construction is the best you can choose!

reviews.author: Ken
reviews.text: David was helpful with our medical spa buildout. Communication was clear during and before the construction process. There was always somebody available to pick up our call or address any questions. I will call anytime I need a contractor.

reviews.author: Reinier
reviews.text: I recently hired BCG Home Renovations for my home remodeling project, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. Their work is outstanding, with excellent finishes and a remarkable attention to detail. They were incredibly efficient throughout the entire process, completing everything on time and exceeding my expectations in quality. I highly recommend BCG Home Renovations to anyone looking for top-notch craftsmanship and a smooth renovation experience.

reviews.author: Renoma Serrano
reviews.text: I recently hired BCG Home Renovations for a bathroom remodel, and I’m thrilled with the outcome. The team was professional, attentive to my ideas, and showed incredible attention to detail. The entire process was smooth, and the quality of workmanship is outstanding. Highly recommend BCG Home Renovations for anyone seeking top-notch service and beautiful results!

reviews.author: Casey Hegg
reviews.text: We’ve worked with David Rooh, Humberto, and the Bowser Construction Group multiple times now, and they’ve consistently exceeded expectations. They’re responsive, reliable, and bring a high level of professionalism to complex, fast-moving work. Their team understands the importance of communication, schedule, and quality, and they’ve been a strong partner throughout. Highly recommend.
